subject: Archival extract & preservation specification — evidence package request
body:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@regalhealth.com>

Subject: Request: archival extract & preservation specification

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our RFP we need a detailed description of Redwood's archival export deliverables for audit/legal preservation. Specifically the Security and Legal teams at Regal want answers for the following:

- What is included in an "evidence package" (log types, metadata, manifests, checksums, chain-of-custody).
- Supported export formats (JSONL, Parquet, CSV, raw protobuf) and recommended schema.
- Retention windows and how retention is enforced and audited.
- How we can request ad-hoc snapshots for legal hold and expected lead time/cost.
- Delivery mechanisms (S3 presigned URL, SFTP, encrypted archive) and encryption measures in transit/at rest.
- Proof of integrity (signed manifests, checksums, audit trail entries).
- Redaction/anonymization options for exports and whether PII can be excluded.

Would appreciate a single-place document we can attach to our RFP. Can you also include the SLAs for export request turnaround and how large exports are packaged?

Best,
Anna Keller
Director, Security & Compliance
Regal Health Systems

Hi Anna — following up with a consolidated response to the points you raised. Below is a summary you can plug into your RFP; I included specific capabilities, delivery options, and our standard SLAs. Aditya and Laura helped validate the security wording.

Summary: Redwood Evidence Package (v2.1) — quick bullets
- Package contents: primary audit logs (auth, API calls, model invocation events), generated output logs (if requested), configuration snapshots (model version, quantization profile), access-control changes, routing/fallback events, and a machine-readable manifest.json detailing file inventory and checksums.
- Formats: Exports available in JSONL (default), Parquet (columnar for analytics), and gzipped CSV. We also provide raw protobuf dumps for engineering engagements. Schema recommendations are included in the attached spec.
- Integrity & sign-off: Every package includes SHA-256 checksums for each object and a top-level manifest signed with Redwood's PKI (X.509), plus optional PGP-signed bundles for customer requirements. Manifests include UTC timestamped audit entries describing the export request, operator ID, and delivery hash.
- Delivery methods: Encrypted S3 with per-object SSE-KMS and time-limited presigned URLs (recommended), mutually authenticated SFTP, or an encrypted HTTPS archive (PGP/ZIP). For highest-assurance deliveries we can also ship to your WORM S3 bucket with object lock + versioning enabled. Example presigned workflow in attachment.
- Retention enforcement: Retention windows are enforced via an immutable retention metadata layer and audited daily. Customers can configure retention at org, project, or route level. Retention policy changes are logged and immutable audit entries are produced for compliance review.
- Ad-hoc snapshots & lead time: Standard SLA: 72 hours for ad-hoc exports up to 5 TB after request acceptance. For exports >5 TB we offer expedited scheduling (24–48 hours) with reserved capacity under Dedicated plans; planning estimate and cost provided on request. Typical large export packaging uses chunked tar.gz parts and a manifest for reassembly.
- Incremental exports: Yes — change-only deltas supported for audit logs and metadata using sequence-based snapshots. Deltas are delivered as patch files with corresponding manifest entries so you can reconstruct full state.
- Chain-of-custody & tamper resistance: Export operator actions, timestamps, and transfer logs are captured as part of the package. We can provide notarization evidence (signed manifest, transfer logs, and optional third-party hash notarization on request).
- PII redaction and pseudonymization: Export-time filters allow exclusion of user-content fields or redaction to hashed identifiers. We support configurable redaction profiles (full redact, tokenized pseudonymization, or field-level masking).
- Legal hold support: Ability to create hold flags that persist objects beyond standard retention; holds are gated by owner and audited.
- Costs & billing: Standard exports fall under Support inclusion up to 1 TB per quarter; ad-hoc large exports are quoted based on size and required turnaround. We can provide a line-item in the SOW for export deliverables.

Attachments included for RFP: Redwood_Evidence_Package_Spec_v2.1.pdf (full spec), sample-manifest-20261029.json, and s3-presigned-example.txt.

Next steps:
- If this covers your needs I can convert the bullets into an RFP-ready appendix and sign an NDA/RFI attestation.
- If you want a live walkthrough of the evidence package and a short demo of an export, propose 30 minutes and we'll schedule.

Procurement note: Our default 72-hour SLA is achievable for most customers; for formal contract language we offer an express export SLA addendum for Dedicated customers with committed capacity.

If you want I can also add a sample chain-of-custody timeline and a redaction-example CSV to the packet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
